title: Night Circuit
summary: A dark electronic theme with electric cyan metering, vivid violet accents, and a luminous magenta-blue intensity scale.
descriptionMarkdown: Night Circuit is designed for late-night electronic production and sound design. Deep indigo surfaces create a focused backdrop for electric cyan primary data, vivid magenta secondary traces, and violet accents. A cyan-to-violet-to-magenta metering scale ties the analytical views together, giving the workspace a luminous digital character without overwhelming the measurements.
